original.target_description: Study 1, SNS-only person-level model predicting average strength of music-evoked nostalgia; not the combined personality model.

n.sample_role: Participants nested within song presentations; target-test analytic count not explicitly printed.
n.exclusions: Not documented for the selected model; reported study sample is 226 and reported song presentations are 6,720. These are not automatically test-specific analytic counts.
n.quote: Participants were 226 University of California, Davis, psychology undergraduate student volunteers; Of the 6,720 song presentations during the experiment

es.location: p. 394 (PDF p. 5), Person-Level Measures and Nostalgia, SNS-only model
es.quote: When we included only the SNS, it signiﬁcantly predicted strength of music-evoked nostalgia in the expected direction, β = .1082, t(224) = 2.81, p < .01.

p.location: p. 394 (PDF p. 5), Person-Level Measures and Nostalgia, SNS-only model
p.quote: When we included only the SNS, it signiﬁcantly predicted strength of music-evoked nostalgia in the expected direction, β = .1082, t(224) = 2.81, p < .01.

replication.target_description: Study 1, SNS-only person-level multilevel model predicting continuous nostalgia rating across songs and conditions, random participant intercept.

n.sample_role: Participants (clusters); 2,234 song-level observations in the final paired-song analysis.
n.exclusions: 14 removed for improper responses; 172 without appropriately matched control songs excluded. Only complete nostalgia/control song pairs retained.
n.location: p. 3 Participants; p. 4 Statistical Analysis; p. 5 Results; p. 9 Table 7 documents same final sample in combined models
n.quote: leaving 582 participants included in the ﬁnal analysis.

es.location: p. 5 Results, Person-Level Measures, individual SNS model
es.quote: SNS score was a signiﬁcant predictor of nostalgia rating, β = 0.20, t(2232) = 3.16, p < .01

p.location: p. 5 Results, Person-Level Measures, individual SNS model
p.quote: SNS score was a signiﬁcant predictor of nostalgia rating, β = 0.20, t(2232) = 3.16, p < .01

reported_success.quote: Overall, the results of the present study are largely consistent with Barrett et al. (2010), conceptually replicating the ﬁndings

notes: Single-scale SNS models selected on both sides from assigned pages. Original also prints combined-model SNS coefficients .1116 and .1075 elsewhere; these are different tests. Success is an overall author verdict, not a separately stated effect-specific replication classification. Replication individual-model p is not labeled adjusted in prose. Original analytic n left null because the study-level total is not explicitly established for the selected test; no n derived from degrees of freedom.
